subject: Procurement clearance: legal → security → finance milestone plan
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@livwellhealth.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@livwellhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Procurement clearance: legal → security → finance milestone plan

Hi Emily / Raj —

Thanks again for a productive discovery today. Quick recap and a proposed cadence so we can align internal approvers on both sides:

Summary of ask from Livwell: adopt Redwood Dedicated for inference of clinical summarization pipeline. Procurement path you indicated: legal review → infosec assessment → finance signoff → PO issuance (or marketplace purchase if preferred). We captured a target go-live window at the end of Q3.

My suggested milestone plan (high level):
- Week 0 (this week): Share draft MPA + technical SSO/SCIM appendix (attached).
- Week 1–2: Livwell legal review (internal redlines) — Redwood legal ready to iterate.
- Week 2–3: Security questionnaire / technical call with our infra/security team.
- Week 3–4: Finance review (procurement ops) — decision on PO vs corporate card vs marketplace.
- Week 4–6: Final MPA sign + PO issuance or marketplace purchase.

Open items for our mutual action plan:
1) Emily to confirm who will own the Livwell legal redlines and an expected completion date.
2) Raj to confirm the security reviewer and best times for a 30-min technical call.
3) We to deliver a tailored procurement timeline spreadsheet for you to share with stakeholders (attached).

Attachments: Redwood_MPA_v1.2.pdf (MPA draft), procurement-timeline-milestones.xlsx (proposed milestones), Livwell_SOW_Template.docx (for scope alignment).

If you prefer marketplace procurement (AWS Marketplace), note that process shortens finance review but requires marketplace SKUs — we can prepare a marketplace quote in parallel.

Would you be available for a 20-min checkpoint next Wednesday, Apr 22 at 10am PT? If yes, I’ll send a calendar invite and include Ben (CS lead) who will coordinate the security call.

Thanks —
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
(415) 555-0139
From: Emily Chen <emily.chen@livwellhealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@livwellhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2026 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Procurement clearance: legal → security → finance milestone plan

Naomi — thanks for the clear recap and the docs. Sharing answers inline: 

1) Legal owner: I’ll own the initial review and will share redlines to you by Friday, Apr 24. We’ll escalate any substantive commercial changes to our GC (Mark Liu).
2) Security reviewer: Raj will loop in our cloud security lead (cloudsec@livwellhealth.com). Raj, can you suggest 2 slots for a 30-min call next week?
3) Finance path: Our default is PO issuance. We only use marketplace for small purchases below our procurement threshold — for this scale we expect a PO.

Timeline: we’re targeting legal signoff + PO issuance in the first half of May, which should keep the end-of-Q3 go-live feasible if there are no major redlines. I’ll attach our SOW template; we may ask you to mirror naming conventions for billing.

Also: please include a short one-pager on your data handling and retention policy for the security team — they’ll want that up front.

Emily Chen
Sr. Director, Strategic Procurement | Livwell Health
emily.chen@livwellhealth.com
(617) 555-2210
From: Raj Patel <raj.patel@livwellhealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Emily Chen <emily.chen@livwellhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Apr 2026 11:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Procurement clearance: legal → security → finance milestone plan

Looping in our cloud security lead (cc’d as cloudsec@livwellhealth.com in a separate note). Two slots that work: Wed Apr 22 at 11am ET / Thu Apr 23 at 9am ET. Either is fine — would prefer the earlier slot if possible.

We’ll want: network diagram, data flow for inference calls, retention policy, and a short compliance matrix (SOC2 / encryption in transit and at rest). If Redwood can provide those before the call, it’ll accelerate the review.

Thanks —
Raj
Director, Cloud Operations | Livwell Health
raj.patel@livwellhealth.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Chen <emily.chen@livwellhealth.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@livwellhealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Apr 2026 10:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Procurement clearance: legal → security → finance milestone plan

Emily / Raj / Naomi — quick note from the CS side.

We’ll prepare the security packet Naomi mentioned:
- 1-page data retention & handling summary (attached draft).
- Compliance matrix: SOC2, encryption, network isolation bullets.
- A short runbook for the planned onboarding (canary + staging timeline).

Naomi — I recommend we offer a 2-week staging window once PO is issued so Livwell can validate latency and KV cache behavior against a small production dataset (no PHI). If they need an accelerated marketplace route to shorten finance, we can provide a marketplace quote in parallel but the staging timeline is unchanged.

Attachments (from Redwood CS): redwood-data-retention-onepager.pdf (PDF, 18KB), onboarding-canary-plan.md (text).

I’ll join the security call if scheduled Wed 11am ET tomorrow.

—Ben
Ben Carter

Date: Fri, 24 Apr 2026 09:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Procurement clearance: legal → security → finance milestone plan

Appreciate the quick responses. Finalizing next steps here so the mutual action plan is explicit:

1) Legal: Emily to send redlines by EOD Apr 24 — Redwood legal will respond within 48 business hours.
2) Security: Call confirmed Wed Apr 22 11am ET (Ben and our infra lead will join) — Raj, thanks for arranging; please include the cloudsec contact on the invite.
3) Finance: Emily confirmed PO path; target PO issuance by May 8 if legal redlines are minor.
4) Marketplace: Redwood will run parallel pricing and can produce a marketplace SKU if Livwell requests — note this only shortens finance approval for smaller purchases.
5) Staging: Ben to coordinate a 2-week canary/staging window post-PO.

I’ve uploaded the procurement timeline spreadsheet and a lightweight mutual action plan to Drive for shared edits: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2bProcTimeline — please add dates and owners.

Next checkpoint: I’ll hold a 20-min sync on Thu, Apr 29 at 10am PT to go over redlines and the security call notes. If that doesn’t work for your team, propose an alternate.

Thanks again — looking forward to moving this forward.

Naomi Feldman
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
